units.english: The most common Heliarch patrol ship, Neutralizers are designed to be just strong enough to keep an enemy vessel occupied until reinforcements can arrive.
units.raw: description `The most common Heliarch patrol ship, Neutralizers are designed to be just strong enough to keep an enemy vessel occupied until reinforcements can arrive.`

units.english: Although not quite as strong or powerful as the Quarg ships that they are designed to oppose, Heliarch Punishers are versatile and durable ships. Rumors say that the Heliarchs have a small stash of stolen Quarg Skylances that they can outfit the Punishers with in times of war.
units.raw: description `Although not quite as strong or powerful as the Quarg ships that they are designed to oppose, Heliarch Punishers are versatile and durable ships. Rumors say that the Heliarchs have a small stash of stolen Quarg Skylances that they can outfit the Punishers with in times of war.`

units.english: Occasionally, when a Heliarch cadet shows promising results in dogfighting simulations, they are allowed to fly a ship of their own: the Pursuer.
units.raw: description `Occasionally, when a Heliarch cadet shows promising results in dogfighting simulations, they are allowed to fly a ship of their own: the Pursuer.`

units.english: Though certainly not as durable as the other fighters in Coalition space, this Kimek design is cheaper to produce and capable of outrunning any other Coalition ship.
units.raw: description `	Though certainly not as durable as the other fighters in Coalition space, this Kimek design is cheaper to produce and capable of outrunning any other Coalition ship.`

units.english: Fighters do not come equipped with a hyperdrive. You cannot carry a fighter unless you have a ship in your fleet with a fighter bay.
units.raw: description "	Fighters do not come equipped with a hyperdrive. You cannot carry a fighter unless you have a ship in your fleet with a fighter bay."

units.english: The very first fighter they designed, Rovers are well-rounded ships that the Heliarchs employ regularly due to their reliability in any situation.
units.raw: description `The very first fighter they designed, Rovers are well-rounded ships that the Heliarchs employ regularly due to their reliability in any situation.`

units.english: Boasting incredible durability for a ship this size, the Stalker is a compact fortress that can take serious punishment and recover faster than some warships. Its speed and maneuverability, however, leave much to be desired.
units.raw: description `Boasting incredible durability for a ship this size, the Stalker is a compact fortress that can take serious punishment and recover faster than some warships. Its speed and maneuverability, however, leave much to be desired.`

units.english: With more than twice the population of the Saryds and Arachi combined, the Kimek are constantly in need of transport ships to carry individuals from one world to another.
units.raw: description `With more than twice the population of the Saryds and Arachi combined, the Kimek are constantly in need of transport ships to carry individuals from one world to another.`

units.english: The Spire is the largest passenger transport in Coalition space, able to carry nearly three hundred individuals... as long as they're comfortable staying in the tiny bunk rooms that are primarily designed to meet the needs of a Kimek. Most of the ceilings are too short for a Saryd to stand up straight, and the beds are too small for an Arach to stretch their legs out comfortably.
units.raw: description `The Spire is the largest passenger transport in Coalition space, able to carry nearly three hundred individuals... as long as they're comfortable staying in the tiny bunk rooms that are primarily designed to meet the needs of a Kimek. Most of the ceilings are too short for a Saryd to stand up straight, and the beds are too small for an Arach to stretch their legs out comfortably.`

units.english: The Kimek love traveling so much that some of them will happily spend months at a time in a transport this size, and the passengers often grow into a tight-knit community by the end of their journeys together.
units.raw: description `The Kimek love traveling so much that some of them will happily spend months at a time in a transport this size, and the passengers often grow into a tight-knit community by the end of their journeys together.`

units.english: The Thorn is the Kimek equivalent of a shuttle, and thanks to their speed and maneuverability they are used throughout Coalition space for transferring passengers from one ship to another or from a planet into orbit.
units.raw: description `The Thorn is the Kimek equivalent of a shuttle, and thanks to their speed and maneuverability they are used throughout Coalition space for transferring passengers from one ship to another or from a planet into orbit.`

units.english: Saryds place high value both on solitude, but also on community and collaboration. So, it is not surprising that their smallest spacefaring vessel requires a team of at least two individuals to operate it. It is quite common for a lone Saryd to take on a Kimek or Arach copilot as a way of building cross-species friendships.
units.raw: description `Saryds place high value both on solitude, but also on community and collaboration. It is quite common for a lone Saryd to take on a Kimek or Arach copilot as a way of building cross-species friendships.`

units.english: When the first wars were fought against the Quarg, the Saryds had been spacefaring for more than ten thousand Earth years, and their starship technology was considerably more advanced than the Kimek or the Arachi. At that time, ships similar to the modern Sojourner were the most powerful capital ships in the Coalition fleet.

units.english: Travelers were originally designed as science vessels, thousands of years ago before the Saryds had catalogued all the life forms and physical phenomena of every world in Coalition space. Today, many Saryd communities still choose to live in a Traveler and journey together from system to system rather than putting down roots on a planet.

units.english: Rather than specializing in carrying passengers or carrying cargo, Saryds seek to make their ships as well-balanced and versatile as possible. As a result, the crew of a typical Visitor can count on performing a different sort of job every week.
